items.title: 15.5 Basic organization of human nervous system (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the organisation of the nervous system (PDF 36).

blocks.text: Insani nervous system central nervous system (CNS) aur peripheral nervous system (PNS) par mushtamil hai. CNS dimagh aur spinal cord se bana hai. PNS cranial aur spinal nerves se bana hai jo bil-tarteeb dimagh aur spinal cord se nikalti hain. Nerves sensory aur motor raaste (pathways) banati hain. Motor raaste do hain: (i) iradi (voluntary ya somatic) nervous system jo iradi (skeletal) muscles ko qaboo karta hai, aur (ii) autonomic nervous system jo be-iradah (involuntary) muscles aur glands ko qaboo karta hai. Autonomic system sympathetic aur parasympathetic nervous systems par mushtamil hai.

blocks.alt: Darakht-numa chart. Nervous system ke do hisse: Central nervous system (Brain, Spinal cord) aur Peripheral nervous system (Sensory pathways, Motor pathways). Motor pathways ke do hisse Somatic nervous system aur Autonomic nervous system; autonomic ke do hisse Sympathetic aur Parasympathetic nervous system.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.8: Nervous system ki bunyadi tanzeem (kitab ki Figure 15.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chart ko upar se neeche parhein: nervous system ke do bare hisse CNS (dimagh, spinal cord) aur PNS hain. PNS ke sensory aur motor raaste hain; motor raaste somatic aur autonomic mein batte hain, aur autonomic aage sympathetic aur parasympathetic mein.

blocks.prompt: Dil ki dharkan kaun sa hissa qaboo karta hai, aur haath uthane ka faisla kaun sa?
blocks.explanation: Dil ki dharkan: autonomic nervous system (be-iradah). Haath uthana: skeletal muscles chalane wala somatic (iradi) nervous system.

items: CNS: dimagh aur spinal cord. PNS: cranial aur spinal nerves, sensory aur motor raaston mein; motor = somatic (iradi) + autonomic (sympathetic, parasympathetic).
